subject: Democrats Warned About Foreign Election Interference Then Hired Foreign Nationals
posts: Exposing Democratic hypocrisy on foreign nationals in campaigns while ignoring legal TPS distinctions. #Aletheia #USPol

Democrats hypocritically hired foreign nationals for election work after years of condemning foreign election interference.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.6) — Good Preference

Employing legal TPS holders for campaign support is lawful labor, conflated with state interference for partisan point-scoring.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.6) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception. Conflating legal immigrant labor with illicit state interference manufactures partisan outrage.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 6.5, z: 2)

- The Federalist Framing: FAIL (-0.7, -0.6) — Equates legal TPS labor with foreign interference.
- Democratic Party Actions: COND (+0.2, -0.2) — Lawful employment, clumsy messaging.
The Federalist highlights a New Yorker report on a TPS worker helping Democratic campaigns, weaponizing it against past anti-interference rhetoric.

The Poison:
Weaponizing individual immigrant worker statuses to score partisan points against past election integrity warnings distorts immigration reality.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (legal employment of temporary protected status workers) with WHO (state-level foreign election interference actors).

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors run a Smart Selfish maneuver. By substituting a legal immigration labor issue into a menacing foreign interference pretext, they project hypocrisy onto opponents to manufacture outrage.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Net force pulls away from transparency (-0.7).

The Unavoidable Truth: Legal TPS workers are permitted to hold jobs in the U.S.

The Unavoidable Lie: Hiring a TPS consultant equates to foreign election hacking.
